run: P2.85 run 2, approved by whip-lead 2026-11-26: the positive control redteam asked for on E314's error share
descriptive: a control on E314's error share, reported as a description; no verdict on reuse

settings.gain_floor_source: the error share's floors in E314's predictions.json (trained: E136's two-sided floor, nan under it; random: share only if |gain| >= 1 log-odds, else null with the reason)

reader: E314's run.py Reader built from E314's predictions.json settings (same SAEs, rows, read position, target, fp32); same 48 states; random references with E314's seeds (int(sha256(state name)[:8], 16), finetune.random_direction)

recon_share.definition: (L_recon - T0) / (T1 - T0); L_recon = base model with each of the 8 block-output sites set to hat(o_FT) + e(o_cur), computed o_cur + (hat(o_FT) - hat(o_cur)), all 8 at once, every position
recon_share.zero_update: numerator L_recon - T0 exactly 0; share nan (0/0)
recon_share.control: full patch (o_FT at all 8 sites) reproduces T1: max |logit - FT logit| at the read position within the run-to-run floor measured in stage 0 (share 1)
recon_share.random: share read only where |gain| >= 1 log-odds (E314: no random update reached it); else null with the reason
recon_share.trained_if_rival_a_additive: recon_share ~ 1 - error_share on every task: reuse ~0.26-0.48, new ~0.14-0.38

sum_share.definition: error_share + recon_share, read on the same forwards

expected.error_share_reproduction: the error share read again in this job equals E314's saved error_share per state (trained and random; both null or both nan counts as equal) within the run-to-run floor stage 0 measures (E314 measured 0: deterministic); a miss stops the job naming the state

stage0.rule: first and alone; any miss writes results/results_complement.json stage0.stopped, prints STOP and exits 1
stage0.zero_update: on the first state's rows: gain 0, L_recon - T0 = 0 and L_patch - T0 = 0 exactly, both shares nan
stage0.run_to_run_floor: the first state's fine-tuned model run twice: max |logit| difference at the read position
stage0.full_patch: o_FT at all 8 sites in the base model: max |logit - FT logit| <= the floor

not_run: E234 FVE reproduction, the gain reproduction and Kissane's EV / FVU gaps: unchanged from E314 (results/results.json)
